verdict.rationale: Kick documents a genuine double-entry ledger where every transaction generates a journal entry with matching debits and credits, and the Chart of Accounts can be adjusted by accountants (kick-supp-journal-entries, kick-supp-coa). However, the docs describe journal entries as auto-generated from bank/payroll/bill transactions rather than confirming a manual entry workflow with memo fields for ad hoc accountant adjustments. Missing for 10: explicit manual journal entry creation UI/feature, memo/description field support, and confirmation of balance validation on manual entries.
